name: Product bundle builder
steps: Open a compatible section or parent block in the theme editor, select Add block, and choose Product bundle builder. The parent controls its available space and overall layout.
Configure the block’s content first, then its presentation. Drag the block in its parent to change its position.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Bundle title
settings.how: Enter the bundle title. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Bundle description
settings.how: Use the rich text editor for paragraphs, lists, emphasis, and links. Use descriptive link text and headings in a logical order.
